name: Hashimoto Ken'ichi
source: The protagonist. He is an very ordinary student, but his life is becoming more difficult everyday because of the four girls confessing to him. His personality is if you put it in a good way, gentle and if you put it in a bad way, very donkan. While he likes all the girls, because of his donkan personality he has yet to choose one of them.
